Standing Irish high-retail ceiling benchmark and standard cherry-pick source. User-supplied public member URL is /member/470512; individual listing pages link the seller's 'other ads' search to user-1462668, so preserve both identifiers. Treat asking prices as upper local retail context, not fair market value. Standard cherry-pick screen: English + NM only; verified specialist reference required; target >=20% discount AND >=€1.50 absolute discount after considering landed/basket-adjusted cost. Rocco commonly offers postage up to 10 cards for €2, so distinguish single-card landed economics from combined-postage basket economics. Prioritize stamped, promo, vintage, older holo, scarce variants and popular Pokémon. Give more weight to actual offers, corroborated accepted offers, seller/platform sold states and other evidence of realized buyer willingness. Compare alongside Cardmarket English+NM and European eBay evidence. Current seller pattern includes many modern raw singles at roughly €3-€6 plus combined postage; most are retail rather than sourcing deals. Manual/public-index tracking only; do not automate Adverts.ie retrieval where prohibited by platform Terms.

High-priority full-binder/value benchmark. Seller has repeatedly listed 2016-modern Pokemon binders with rare/holo/reverse-holo content. Two comparable binders (40926024/40926025) were offered at €20; 40926025 had a €20 offer accepted plus multiple backup €20 offers and the pair were later seller/platform marked sold in a user-supplied snapshot. Similar later binders 40960653/40960632 were repriced to €39 after heavy demand. Treat €20 as strong evidence of rapid buyer demand at that level, but do not assume €39 is realized market until sold evidence appears. High-priority alert on new comparable full binders at <=€25; €26-32 is attractive/good-buy territory; ~€39 is fair/watch territory pending sale evidence. Revalidate thresholds as new sales occur. Manual/public-index tracking only; no prohibited automated Adverts.ie scraping/indexing.

Direct competitor benchmark for kids/starter bundles. Current 50-card English pack-fresh bundle is €7: 1 V/EX, 1 reverse holo, 3 holo rares, 5 Trainers, 10 Energy and 30 C/UC with no duplicates. Seller has shown repeat buyer interest and offered 2 bundles for €13 including postage; profile feedback includes buyers praising card quality/delivery. Also useful for raw-bulk calibration: Vivid Voltage C/UC at 100 for €6 or 200 for €10; Energy at 50 for €3 or 200 for €10. Use this seller as the main €7 value-tier benchmark against our current €7 Premium: ours should differentiate through themes, 7 holo/RH, no Energy filler, stronger hero-card presentation and cleaner gift feel. Do not infer a sale from €1 PM placeholder offers alone. Manual/public-index tracking only; no prohibited automated Adverts.ie scraping/indexing.

Cross-platform bulk-plus-accessories competitor. Current Adverts listing 40975469 asks €30 plus €8 postage for 216 counted Pokemon cards (120 Basic, 60 Stage 1, 6 Stage 2, 30 Trainers) plus a new Energy pack, Destined Rivals sleeve pack, dice, counters, 2 coins and 3 sticker sheets. A very similar older listing 40483882 also asked €30; a €20 offer drew a seller counter/willingness at €25, useful as price-resistance evidence but not a sale. Same current lot was cross-posted to Vinted item 9926968177 and is now marked Removed there while Adverts remains active; do not infer a sale from Vinted removal. Benchmark mainly for parent-facing starter lots and accessory perceived value, not direct like-for-like competition with our curated €5/€7 kids bundles.

Direct €5 kids-bundle competitor and high-trust seller benchmark. Listing 29492756 asks €5 for 50 English Sword & Shield-era cards, no duplicates, normally no Energy, guaranteed V/ultra-rare shiny card wording, plus a stated 2 holo + 2 reverse-holo cards within a common/uncommon/rare mix; postage €2.50 and multiple bundles available. Current listing has repeated €5 offers and recent Still Available updates. Seller profile is Top Seller/verified, member since 2014, 270 positive/0 negative feedback and 205 sold ads at the 2026-09-09 snapshot. Recent feedback from usernames also appearing among bundle offers is suggestive of real bundle turnover, but exact linkage/realized transaction prices are not independently proven. This is the main benchmark/threat for our €5 Standard because it includes a V at the same headline price; our differentiation must be 9 holo/RH, theme curation, recognizable Pokémon and better presentation rather than simply card count. Manual/public-index tracking only; no prohibited direct automation of Adverts.ie.

Track visible sticker prices at Dublin pop-up stock, especially €5–15 raw singles. Use as face-to-face Irish retail ceiling and occasional sourcing lead. Separate English and Japanese comps; in-person inspection/no postage can justify a modest premium over Cardmarket, but not large markup.
